meaning.en: To understand or foresee things before others do.
meaning.zh: 比一般人更早地认识、觉悟。

examples.zh: 他对行业趋势先知先觉，早早转了型。
examples.en: He saw the industry trend coming and changed course early.

examples.zh: 先知先觉的人往往最先行动。
examples.en: Those who sense things early are usually first to act.

story.en: Mencius: Heaven let those who understand first awaken those who understand later (使先知觉后知，使先觉觉后觉).
story.zh: 《孟子》：“天之生此民也，使先知觉后知，使先觉觉后觉也。”

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; contrasts with 后知后觉.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，与“后知后觉”相对。

meaning.en: To leap over eaves and run along walls, as martial-arts heroes or burglars do.
meaning.zh: 形容武艺高强，能在房檐和墙壁上快速行走；也指轻功。

equivalents: scale roofs and walls like a cat

examples.zh: 武侠片里的高手个个会飞檐走壁。
examples.en: The masters in martial-arts films can all leap over roofs and walls.

examples.zh: 那个小偷练过飞檐走壁的本事。
examples.en: The thief had trained in roof-climbing tricks.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often in kung fu or crime stories.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常见于武侠、侦探故事。

meaning.en: To spread one's wings and fly high; to launch an ambitious career.
meaning.zh: 张开翅膀高高飞翔，比喻施展才能、前程远大。

examples.zh: 毕业生们即将展翅高飞。
examples.en: The graduates are about to spread their wings.

examples.zh: 祝你在新的岗位上展翅高飞！
examples.en: May you soar in your new post!

usage.en: Predicate; often used in good wishes.

meaning.en: To keep a business going through painstaking effort in hard conditions.
meaning.zh: 原指作画时费尽心思布局构图；后指在艰难的条件下苦心经营。

examples.zh: 这家小书店惨淡经营了十年。
examples.en: The little bookshop struggled on for ten years.

examples.zh: 他惨淡经营，才有了今天的局面。
examples.en: Only through painstaking effort did he reach today's position.

story.en: Du Fu's poem on painting: the artist plans with painstaking care (诏谓将军拂绢素，意匠惨淡经营中).
story.zh: 杜甫《丹青引赠曹将军霸》：“诏谓将军拂绢素，意匠惨淡经营中。”

usage.en: Predicate; often about a small business.

meaning.en: Rolling continuously up and down, of hills and mountains.
meaning.zh: 形容山脉等连续不断、高低起伏。

examples.zh: 窗外是连绵起伏的丘陵。
examples.en: Outside the window are rolling hills.

examples.zh: 草原上群山连绵起伏。
examples.en: Ranges roll one after another over the grassland.

meaning.en: Strict punishments and severe laws.
meaning.zh: 严厉的刑罚和苛刻的法律。

examples.zh: 光靠严刑峻法并不能根除犯罪。
examples.en: Draconian laws alone cannot wipe out crime.

examples.zh: 秦朝以严刑峻法著称。
examples.en: The Qin dynasty was known for its harsh laws.

usage.zh: 多作宾语、定语，常含批评。

meaning.en: So obvious that even passers-by know it.
meaning.zh: 连路上的行人都知道，形容事情尽人皆知。

examples.zh: 他想另起炉灶，这已是路人皆知。
examples.en: That he wants to start his own venture is an open secret.

examples.zh: 司马昭之心，路人皆知。
examples.en: Everyone can see what Sima Zhao is up to.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 司马昭之心.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“司马昭之心”连用。

meaning.en: To fuss over wording, or to show off one's book learning.
meaning.zh: 过分斟酌字句；也指爱卖弄文辞。

examples.zh: 写报告要认真，但不必咬文嚼字。
examples.en: Write the report carefully, but there is no need to quibble over words.

examples.zh: 他说话爱咬文嚼字，让人听着累。
examples.en: He likes to talk pedantically, which is tiring to listen to.

usage.en: Predicate; can be mildly negative or neutral.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，略带贬义或中性。

literal: touch · scene · give rise to · feeling

meaning.en: To be stirred to feeling by what one sees.
meaning.zh: 看到眼前的景物，引起感情上的触动。

examples.zh: 看到老房子，他触景生情，想起了童年。
examples.en: Seeing the old house, he was moved to recall his childhood.

examples.zh: 触景生情，诗人写下了这首词。
examples.en: Stirred by the scene, the poet wrote this lyric.

pinyin: chū shēng niú dú bù pà hǔ
natural: a newborn calf does not fear the tiger

meaning.en: Young people, new to the world, boldly face challenges without fear.
meaning.zh: 比喻年轻人阅历少，敢作敢为，无所畏惧。

examples.zh: 初生牛犊不怕虎，新人敢挑战老将。
examples.en: Newcomers are fearless, daring to challenge the veteran.

examples.zh: 他刚入行就接大项目，真是初生牛犊不怕虎。
examples.en: Taking on a big project right out of the gate, he fears nothing.

meaning.en: Stubborn and defiant; unwilling to be tamed.
meaning.zh: 性情倔强，不驯服，不听从管束。

examples.zh: 这匹马桀骜不驯，没人能骑。
examples.en: This horse is unruly and nobody can ride it.

examples.zh: 他年轻时桀骜不驯，不服任何管教。
examples.en: In his youth he was defiant and bridled at any discipline.

meaning.en: Whoever makes the first move gets the advantage.
meaning.zh: 抢先动手就能占据主动，掌握优势。

equivalents: the early bird gets the worm

examples.zh: 这个单子很抢手，先下手为强。
examples.en: This deal is in demand; make the first move.

examples.zh: 他觉得先下手为强，于是抢先报了价。
examples.en: Believing the first mover wins, he put in his bid early.

story.en: Han Shu: Yin Tong urges 'Act first and you control others; act late and you are controlled' (先发制人，后发制于人).

usage.en: Saying; often 先下手为强，后下手遭殃.

meaning.en: To die or be ruined utterly; also to sacrifice oneself.
meaning.zh: 身体粉碎，形容为某种目的牺牲生命，或指彻底毁灭。

examples.zh: 纵然粉身碎骨，也要完成任务。
examples.en: Even at the cost of my life, I will complete the mission.

examples.zh: 从悬崖摔下去必然粉身碎骨。
examples.en: A fall from the cliff means being smashed to pieces.

meaning.en: To search or travel everywhere; to possess superhuman powers.
meaning.zh: 形容想尽办法到处寻找；也指本领极大。

examples.zh: 为了找到她，他上天入地，几乎走遍全国。
examples.en: To find her, he went everywhere, covering nearly the whole country.

examples.zh: 孙悟空上天入地，无所不能。
examples.en: Sun Wukong can go anywhere in heaven and earth.

meaning.en: Said on suddenly understanding the reason for something.
meaning.zh: 表示恍然明白了事情的原因。

examples.zh: 原来如此，我还以为是他的错呢。
examples.en: I see, I thought it was his fault.

examples.zh: 听了解释，他点点头说：“原来如此。”
examples.en: After the explanation, he nodded and said, 'So that's it.'

meaning.en: Good things often meet setbacks on the way to being achieved.
meaning.zh: 美好的事情在成功之前往往会遇到许多波折。

equivalents: good things come to those who wait
the course of true love never did run smooth

examples.zh: 别灰心，好事多磨。
examples.en: Don't lose heart; good things take time.

examples.zh: 他们的婚事一再推迟，真是好事多磨。
examples.en: Their wedding has been delayed again and again; good things really do take time.

story.en: Used in Wang Shifu's play Romance of the Western Chamber about the lovers' trials (好事多磨).
story.zh: 此语见于元代王实甫《西厢记》，写张生与崔莺莺姻缘多波折。

literal: small weight · small weight · must · compare

meaning.en: To quibble over every trifling amount.
meaning.zh: 一点点小数目也要计较，形容非常吝啬或斤斤计较。

examples.zh: 他对朋友也锱铢必较，没人愿意和他合伙。
examples.en: He haggles even with friends, so nobody wants to partner with him.

examples.zh: 做生意不能锱铢必较。
examples.en: In business you can't fuss over every last penny.

meaning.en: To provoke trouble and cause disputes.
meaning.zh: 招惹是非，引起纠纷。

examples.zh: 这孩子爱惹是生非，老师很头疼。
examples.en: The boy loves stirring up trouble, which gives his teacher a headache.

examples.zh: 别去那种地方惹是生非。
examples.en: Don't go to places like that and cause trouble.

natural: get stuck on a trivial point

meaning.en: To waste effort on a trivial or unsolvable point, or be stubborn.
meaning.zh: 比喻费力研究无价值或解决不了的问题，也指固执、想不开。

examples.zh: 别钻牛角尖了，换个思路试试。
examples.en: Stop going down that rabbit hole and try another approach.

examples.zh: 她爱钻牛角尖，一件小事想好几天。
examples.en: She tends to obsess, mulling over small things for days.

meaning.en: To break one's promises and betray moral obligations.
meaning.zh: 违背诺言，抛弃道义。

examples.zh: 他背信弃义，出卖了合伙人。
examples.en: He broke faith and sold out his partner.

examples.zh: 这种背信弃义的行为令人不齿。
examples.en: Such treachery is despicable.

meaning.en: A couple living together happily until old age.
meaning.zh: 夫妻相爱，共同生活到老。

examples.zh: 祝你们新婚快乐，白头偕老！
examples.en: Congratulations on your wedding; may you grow old together!

examples.zh: 他们携手走过五十年，真正做到了白头偕老。
examples.en: Hand in hand for fifty years, they truly grew old together.

story.en: Book of Songs: 'Hold your hand and grow old with you' (执子之手，与子偕老).

usage.en: Wish or predicate; common on wedding occasions.
usage.zh: 多作祝愿语或谓语，婚礼常用。

meaning.en: Telling a story completely and in order, leaving nothing out.
meaning.zh: 比喻叙述时从头到尾，毫无遗漏。

examples.zh: 他把经过一五一十地告诉了警察。
examples.en: He told the police everything that happened, in full detail.

examples.zh: 你一五一十说清楚，别漏掉细节。
examples.en: Tell it all clearly, and leave no detail out.
